title: Concavity of sinusoidal graphs
body: As input values increase, the graph of a sinusoidal function oscillates between concave down and concave up.
ced_evidence: 3.5.A.5: "the graphs of sinusoidal functions oscillate between concave down and concave up"
correction_note: product-owner-directed correction by the Claude session (David, 2026-10-10): the escalated row was corrected against its own CED evidence and re-checked by both independent checkers and the own-family veto

title: Converting frequency to the parameter b
caution: The relationship fixes the magnitude of b: a frequency of 200 cycles per second gives |b| = 400 pi, and b may be negative with the same period and frequency (3.6.A.1 permits any nonzero real b). Do not set b equal to the frequency or to the period.
